The structure of Nd₂In₄Pd₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 143), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows In centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (4 In, 4 Nd, 4 Pd), Nd centers with 16 neighbors (8 In, 8 Pd), and Pd centers with 9 neighbors (4 In, 2 Nd, 3 Pd). The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between In and Pd polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Pd-centered polyhedra.
